ezekiel.43.p1.b1.text: Then the man brought me back to the gate that faces east, and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.

ezekiel.43.p1.b2.text: … like the visions I had seen by the River Kebar. I fell facedown …

ezekiel.43.p1.b3.text: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court …

ezekiel.43.p1.b4.text: The glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east … the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

ezekiel.43.p2.b1.text: Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever.

ezekiel.43.p2.b2.text: … with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed …

ezekiel.43.p2.b3.text: As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities …

ezekiel.43.p2.b4.text: This is the law of the temple: All its surrounding territory on top of the mountain will be most holy.

ezekiel.43.p3.b1.text: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits … The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth. … The steps of the altar shall face east.

ezekiel.43.p3.b2.text: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar … thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.

ezekiel.43.p3.b3.text: The priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.

ezekiel.43.p3.b4.text: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you …
